agent_self_preservation.description: When tools violate invariants, BTP catches the violation in-process (<35us) and returns a machine-readable JSON remediation hint so the model self-corrects without termination.

remediation_hint.example: Target relative workspace path instead of root filesystem.

compute_silicon_provenance.description: Hardware and sandbox introspection enabling swarms to adapt context size and execution concurrency to physical compute.
supported_accelerators: NVIDIA Blackwell B200 / Hopper H100 / L40S
